career_ladder.note: Civil Judge (Junior Division) / Judicial Magistrate of First Class (JMFC) is the foundational judicial cadre in the Telangana State Judicial Service, governed by the Telangana State Judicial (Service & Cadre) Rules, 2023. Promotional progression across subordinate judiciary ranks follows the recommendations of the Second National Judicial Pay Commission (SNJPC) approved by the Supreme Court of India, with career elevation regulated by the High Court of Telangana under Article 233 and Article 235 of the Constitution.

exam_scheme.note: Selection process conducted by the High Court for the State of Telangana comprises three successive stages: Stage 1 Screening Test (Computer Based Test of 100 objective questions for shortlisting candidates in a 1:10 ratio with 40% qualifying threshold); Stage 2 Written Examination of three descriptive papers (Paper I: Civil Law, Paper II: Criminal Law, Paper III: English Translation & Judgment Writing / Legal Essay, each 100 marks and 3 hours duration); followed by Stage 3 Viva-Voce / Oral Interview (50 marks). Aggregate qualifying percentage in Written Examination and Viva-Voce combined is 60% for OC/EWS, 55% for BC, and 50% for SC/ST.

financial_package.note: Civil Judges (Junior Division) in Telangana are compensated under the Second National Judicial Pay Commission (SNJPC) revised scale of ₹77,840 – ₹1,36,520 with an entry basic pay of ₹77,840. Allowances include Dearness Allowance (DA), House Rent Allowance (HRA) ranging between 10% and 27% (or government residential bungalow), sumptuary allowance, robe allowance, medical allowance, and judicial telephone/book reimbursements.
